lines.text: Many learners say: I am go to school.
Do not use am before a verb like go.
Goes! She goes to work every day.

data.why: Do not use am before a verb like go.
data.memory: I go. Not I am go.

native.tip: لا نضع am قبل الفعل: نقول “I go to school” وليس “I am go”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “I am go to school”؟ 😅 في الإنجليزية لا نستخدم am قبل الفعل، فالجملة الصحيحة “I go to school”. استمع إلى Ama وكرّر معها! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “goes”. لا تضع am أو is قبل الفعل العادي. تدرّب مع اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.tip: We do not put am before a verb: say “I go to school”, not “I am go”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I am go to school”? 😅 In English we do not use am before the verb, so the right sentence is “I go to school”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
